name: Green Memory Kurumaisu no Shoujo to no Jun'ai
original_name: Green Memory 車椅子の少女との純愛
source:
Tatsuo Yamada is a sophomore at Seaside Academy.
He comes to know a wealthy high society girl who also is a quadruple amputee.
Aya lost her arms and legs in an accident (?), but it's her beauty and her undefeatable determination that appeals to so many. Aya is popular, and Tatsuo likes being around her. With her as a friend, good things will come.
Meanwhile, Tatsuo becomes friendly with another girl, Misaki, who he met as a nude model in fine art class.
Aya and Misaki decide to participate in the school festival's beauty contest.
Tatsuo too has to decide, between the girls... a decision of love and fate.
